newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil flat with futures in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil flat with futures in quiet market.

text.p: NWE gas oil was steady to slightly firmer on Tuesday as IPE gas oil futures ended unchanged but some premiums rose, traders said.
July IPE gas oil ended the session unchanged at $160.25 a tonne having traded in a range of $160.00 to $162.00 during the session.

On the heating oil barge market some storage material traded at July IPE -75 cents fob ARA for June delivery, refinery material was pegged some 25 cents above there although traders said there was virtually no June delivery material left.
Looking into July premiums were slightly stronger with heating oil talked around July IPE flat/25 cents.
Traders said prospects into July and August were looking slightly more lively as German and Swiss end-users started to stock up.
Low sulphur diesel remained under pressure from healthy supply with premiums talked around July IPE +$4.75/+$5.0 fob ARA.
Cargoes were slightly firmer with EN590 quoted around July IPE +6.50/+7.0 cif NWE for July delivery. There was talk of material being done into France at around +$7.50 cif NWE.
Premiums for 0.2 percent material remained under pressure amid low demand and healthy supply. Diffs were talked around July IPE -50 cents/flat cif NWE. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
